Watched p43 fail first (node --test tests/pipeline.test.mjs: 42 pass, 1 fail) before the edit; after it, full `node --test` exit 0: 577 tests, 577 pass, 0 fail. Dependants: tests/pipeline.test.mjs, scripts/usage.mjs, tests/commands.test.mjs, tests/evals.test.mjs, tests/merge.test.mjs, tests/skill.test.mjs, docs/architecture/* still correct - the change only adds one key to the finish counts JSON and breaks no existing assertion (full suite green); the committed architecture model and html are not generated from finish counts. scripts/merge.mjs and tests/merge.test.mjs were not touched: the digest was right. Note: the brief's tests.add names tests/merge.test.mjs but the finish output is asserted in tests/pipeline.test.mjs, which is the file owned by this task.
